newsitem.title: USA: Millbrook demands Eastern holder list.
newsitem.headline: Millbrook demands Eastern holder list.

text.p: Millbrook Capital Management Inc said it has formally demanded Eastern Co's shareholder list.
The action came after a decision by a state court in Connecticut, regarding the consolidated lawsuits between Millbrook, and its affiliates and Eastern.
Millbrook said the court ruled in its favor, granting access to the shareholder list that Eastern had previously withheld.
According to Millbrook, the court ruled that Eastern shareholders have a right to be apprised of Millbrook's offer to buy Eastern.
Last July, Millbrook proposed acquiring Eastern for $15 per share, representing a 30 percent premium to the closing price for the prior 30 trading days.
Millbrook said Eastern management rejected this offer and refused to engage in any constructive dialogue to assure the best possible value for all Eastern shareholders.
Eastern officials were not immediately available for comment.
Millbrook said it intends to continue to seek alternatives to maximize Eastern's value for all shareholders. It did not elaborate.
